questions.stem: Which statement about bond breaking and bond making is correct?

options.text: Breaking bonds is exothermic and making bonds is endothermic
Both breaking and making bonds are exothermic
Breaking bonds is endothermic and making bonds is exothermic
Both breaking and making bonds are endothermic

questions.explanation: Breaking bonds always requires energy input (endothermic) because you must overcome the attractive forces holding the atoms together. Making bonds always releases energy (exothermic) because new attractive forces are established.
